spellbook.finance/limitations: The label uses the saved current destination and fails if that preparation is stale or the seller return address is missing.
The PDF is immutable for its receipt. Reusing the same idempotencyKey returns its receipt and a fresh short-lived download URL.
The PDF contains no purchased postage. Printing is not mailing confirmation or carrier acceptance.
Workspace owner role is backend-enforced. This writes only an owner-scoped document receipt.

description: Create or recover the immutable replacement-address PDF for one returned-order task. Use the current preparationId from spellbook_returned_package_work or spellbook_returned_package_reship_prepare. The address label is available directly. A contents page is optional and separate from the intact-package happy path. The receipt identifies its exact order and preparation and includes a short-lived download URL. This prints no postage and does not mean the package was mailed.

caseId.description: Exact return caseId from returned-order work. Required.

context.description: Optional analytics context: briefly describe the user's underlying goal in one sentence. Do not copy prompts, personal details, credentials, identifiers, or tool arguments. Omit for private tasks.

idempotencyKey.description: A caller-generated key retained across retries. Reusing it returns the same immutable document receipt.

includeContents.description: Whether to append the original returned contents as a separate no-price page. Defaults to false; an intact package does not need to be opened.

preparationId.description: The current preparationId for this task. A stale preparation is rejected.

workspaceId.description: The seller workspace from spellbook_workspaces_list. Required.

name: spellbook_returned_package_reship_print
